introHtml: Green work pants offer a professional alternative to traditional khaki or navy, ideal for landscaping, maintenance, and outdoor crews. The earthy tone hides dirt well while maintaining a sharp look. Our green work pants are available in durable cotton blends and performance fabrics, with options for screen-printed or embroidered logos. Whether you need men's or women's styles, these pants keep your team comfortable and on-brand throughout the workday.
